modification.name: Cost-Price Merchant Application - Customer Admin Integration
modification.author: Bariklabs

operation.add:
<script type="text/javascript"><!--
  (function(){
    var ids = [];
    $('.cp-merchant-status').each(function(){
      var id = $(this).data('customer-id');
      if (id) { ids.push(id); }
    });
    if (ids.length) {
      $.ajax({
        url: 'index.php?route=extension/module/cp_merchant/liststatus&user_token={{ user_token }}',
        type: 'post',
        data: { customer_ids: ids },
        dataType: 'json',
        success: function(json) {
          $('.cp-merchant-status').each(function(){
            var id = $(this).data('customer-id');
            var status = json[id];
            $(this).text(status ? status : '-');
          });
        }
      });
    }
  })();
  //--></script>
